side_effects: psychiatric side effects (anxiety, agitation, irritability, delusions, mood elevation, detachment, emotional blunting, psychosis, craving attention, formal thought disorder)
cardiovascular side effects (increased blood pressure, increased heart rate, arrhythmia, palpitations, dizziness, chest tightness, decreased blood pressure on standing)
cognitive side effects (poor memory, poor concentration, confusion, cognitive impairment)
mechanism_of_action: improves mood and reduces depressive symptoms by acting on AMPA, NMDA, and other glutamate receptors; also affects GABAergic and BDNF systems
unsuitable_population: patients with cardiovascular diseases, patients on certain medications that can interact with ketamine (e.g., benzodiazepines, antipsychotics, opioids, alcohol, MAOIs, TCAs, SSRIs, modafinil, amphetamine types of drugs, CYP enzyme inducers like rifampicin, co-administration with ticlopidine)
